nodes.name: virtuoso-gui-debug SKILL spec
nodes.summary: Comprehensive skill specification for automated GUI debugging of Cadence Virtuoso. Covers purpose, prerequisites, SSH/DISPLAY auto-discovery for cloud workstations, a Chinese-language quick guide (连接 Session/发现 DISPLAY/发现窗口/执行 GUI 操作), live-mode and local-mode contracts, output file conventions, allowed operations, constraints, and an 8-section GUI operation playbook (window discovery, coordinate acquisition, click, text input, button submit, close/cancel, modal dialog handling, CIW bootstrap). Includes measured performance optimization guidance (P0/P1/P2) with xdotool baseline latencies, Virtuoso GUI API semantics verified on IC25.1, verified stress/stability/boundary tests from 2026-09-11, layout/schematic X11 interaction policy, layout automation via Cadence SKILL, and a recursive self-improvement (RSI) knowledge base schema. 1105 lines across 74 sections.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown mixed with English and Chinese (zh-Hans) headings; sectionCount=74; dense verification date stamps (2026-09-11, 2026-09-12) anchor measurement claims; references CIW window ids (e.g. 0x1600013) and DISPLAY=:5.0.
